question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Final answer with constructor names
WITH best_drivers AS (
    SELECT tdr.year, tdr.constructor_id, tdr.constructor_ref, tdr.driver_id, tdr.driver_ref,
           CAST(CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as team_driver_rank
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    WHERE CAST(CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
),
last_races AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
final_driver_standings AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points as driver_season_points, ds.position as driver_position
    FROM last_races lr
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON lr.last_race_id = ds.race_id
),
final_constructor_standings AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_season_points, cs.position as constructor_position
    FROM last_races lr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON lr.last_race_id = cs.race_id
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, bd.year, c.constructor_ref, bd.driver_ref,
       ROUND(fds.driver_season_points + fcs.constructor_season_points, 1) as combined_points
FROM best_drivers bd
JOIN final_driver_standings fds ON bd.driver_id = fds.driver_id AND bd.year = fds.year
JOIN final_constructor_standings fcs ON bd.constructor_id = fcs.constructor_id AND bd.year = fcs.year
JOIN constructors c ON bd.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
